title: DealerFee
description: One mandatory, non-government charge or dealer-required add-on included in Vehicle.price, expressed in whole US dollars. Examples include a documentation fee or a required pre-installed protection product. Do not include sales tax, title, registration, or other government charges. Do not include optional products. Fee names SHOULD be specific enough for a buyer to understand what the charge represents and MUST be unique within one fees array.

name.description: Buyer-facing name of the mandatory charge or dealer-required add-on.

amount.description: Amount in whole US dollars. This amount is already included in Vehicle.price and MUST NOT be added to price again.
